title: Modern Mob Spawn
description: A tiny mod that brings modern mob spawn condition into 1.12.2.
body:
# ModernMobSpawn
A tiny mod that brings modern mob spawn condition into 1.12.2.
Allow monster to spawn only at light level 0. Other than that will not spawn.

### Installation
This mod must be installed on client and server.
- Install MinecraftForge
- Copy mod into `mods` folder
